name: Syr Konrad, the Grim
oracle_text:
Whenever another creature dies, or a creature card is put into a graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, or a creature card leaves your graveyard, Syr Konrad deals 1 damage to each opponent.
{1}{B}: Each player mills a card. (They each put the top card of their library into their graveyard.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever another creature dies, or a creature card is put into a graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, or a creature card leaves your graveyard, Syr Konrad deals 1 damage to each opponent.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires whenever a card matching a filter (here: a creature card, any owner, any graveyard) is put into a graveyard, with a from_zones/except-battlefield clause so it can be narrowed to arrivals from anywhere other than the battlefield -- hand (discard), library (mill), stack (countered or resolved), exile, command zone
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The other two clauses are expressible (`creature_dies` / `dies` with exclude_self, and `leaves_graveyard` filtered to creature cards you own), but there is no zone-change-to-graveyard event in trigger_events: `discard` covers only the hand, `dies` and `leaves_battlefield` only the battlefield, and there is no mill event; the trigger's `from_zones` key is read only for spell_cast and land_played. Writing just the two expressible clauses would silently drop the milled/discarded-creature half, which is the card's main engine with its own {1}{B} mill ability.
